content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-p01-rla2ewvf/report.rdl

DateFrom and DateTo should be proper date pickers, not free-text boxes.

name: tool_search_tool_bm25

DateFrom and DateTo are now DateTime report parameters, so Power BI Report Builder will show calendar date pickers for them instead of free-text boxes. Their prompts ("Date From" and "Date To") and the Site parameter are unchanged.

I didn't change the dataset. The report's dataset has no query parameters mapped to DateFrom or DateTo, so I couldn't confirm how the query consumes them. If the query passes them as strings, check that it still works with real dates.
